title: Deep Learning
summary: How neural networks learn representations: neurons, loss, gradient descent, training dynamics, and when depth pays off.
outcomes: Explain neurons, weights, activations, and layers without hand-waving
Describe training as loss minimization via gradient descent and backpropagation
Diagnose learning-rate problems, overfitting, and data issues from training curves
Know when deep learning beats classical ML, and when it doesn't
